name: Revolving Summoner
original_name: りぼる・さもなー Revolving Summoner
source:
Brownie and Orangette, his childhood friend, are magicians. One day, they take a job interview for official magicians to be employed by the royal family. Orangette easily passes it, but Brownie fails.... He tries to summon a magician named Galette, but just her head appears. However, since Galette's power is strong, Brownie gets an extension on his test. One month left.... will he be able finish summoning Galette...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
布朗尼和他的青梅竹馬奧蘭杰特都是魔法師。某天，他們參加了王室正式魔法師的甄選面試。奧蘭杰特輕鬆通過，布朗尼卻失敗了……他嘗試召喚一名叫加萊特的魔法師，結果卻只有她的頭被召喚出來。不過，由於加萊特力量強大，布朗尼獲得了延長考核期限的機會。還剩一個月……他能否完成對加萊特的召喚呢……？

[摘自ErogeShop]
